title: kith-tui AppState::new() placeholder data breaks chat_list/chat_ids parallel invariant
description: app.rs:93-98: AppState::new() sets chat_list=[alice,bob,group-chat] (3 items) but chat_ids=[] (0 items). Code throughout event.rs relies on these being parallel (same length, same indices). chat_ids.get(selected_chat) returning None before load_startup_data runs causes the event loop run() to exit silently (line 879). The placeholder names also briefly display fake data to the user. Fix: initialize both to empty vecs and handle empty-list display state.
